description: Split from fz-mue.12 (Amendment 2, approved by the user, relayed by Elixir Parity 2026-11-20). Macro.expand/2 expands a quoted macro call against a %Macro.Env{} (the caller's) until it is no longer a macro call, as Elixir does. fz-p8p.25 (var!/2) uses it to expand its context alias. Owner: Elixir Parity.
title: Macro.expand/2 expands a quoted macro call in the caller's environment, as in Elixir
